about_the_product.description: Mats by Fitvids. Details:Yoga mats are 71 inches long and 24 inches wide, ensuring comfort for people of all body types and sizes. High density foam material and 1/2-inch thick high.

user_reviews.text: I was really disappointed with this yoga mat. It slips significantly on the floor during use which creates a serious safety concern instead of providing stability. It actually makes it harder to hold poses and put you at risk of slipping or falling. it’s also poor quality in general and already showing signs of where after just two uses. I would not recommend this yoga mat. I now have to deal with bringing it back to the store in hopes of getting a return so far customer service online has not been helpful in remedying the situation.

user_reviews.title: Perfect, just what I was looking for !!!
user_reviews.text: Great thickness , seems durable, love the color , cool strap to transport and carry. Couldn’t be happier would definitely recommend this exercise mat.
